Broke people believe there's a limited amount of money in the world. Rich people know that's a lie.

Kevin Trudeau says the real millionaire mindset isn't about the money you have - it's the belief that you can always create more. Lose it all today, and it comes back, because money is a renewable resource, not a fixed pile.

Opportunities work the same way. They're like trains: miss one, and another is always coming. There's no 'last chance,' no one shot you blew forever.

The people who stay broke are the ones convinced the train already left the station.

Do you believe there's more coming, or do you believe you already missed it?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #richmindset #wealthhabits #abundance #mindset

A shady business deal once stole the one thing Walt Disney thought would make him rich and famous.

Kevin Trudeau tells it this way: Disney drew a cartoon called Oswald the Rabbit. His partners in New York owned the rights, and through the fine print, they fired him and kept it. Disney ended up broke and starting over in California.

A year later, it hit him: Oswald didn't create Walt Disney. Walt Disney created Oswald. If he could create one character, he could create another.

Thirty minutes later, he'd drawn Mickey Mouse.

Nobody can steal your ability to create - only the thing you already made.

#kevintrudeau #waltdisney #mindset #richmindset #moneymindset #wealthhabits

Jeff Skilling - yes, the Enron Jeff Skilling - once handed Kevin Trudeau a business idea that could have made him a fortune.

He stayed up all night designing a little cup that holds your phone in a car's cup holder. 'Pretty good idea,' they agreed. Then nothing happened with it.

A few years later, someone else built the exact same thing. It was called WeatherTech. It sold in the tens of millions, maybe hundreds of millions of dollars. Jeff never made a penny.

Kevin teased him about missing his shot. Jeff just laughed: 'If I could create the cup holder, I can create another invention.'

The idea was never the point. The ability to keep creating was.
